contentList.content: Arcane Archer
Arcane Archers study a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects.
Arcane Archer Lore
You learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature – typical for practitioners of of this elven martial tradition.
You choose to learn either the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Prestidigitation">Prestidigitation</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Druidcraft">Druidcraft</LSTag> cantrip.
You choose to gain proficiency in the <LSTag Tooltip="Arcana">Arcana</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Nature">Nature</LSTag> skills.
Arcane Shots
Gain an Arcane Shot option of your choice. They are all magical effects, and each one is associated with one of the schools of magic.
Arcane Shot Charges
Arcane Archers can unleash special magical effects with some of their shots.
Arcane Shot charges are spent to trigger magical effects a target is hit with a ranged attack.
Arcane Shot Cooldown
Once per turn when you fire an arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the attack action, you can apply one of your Arcane Shot options to that arrow.
Magic Arrow

You gain the ability to infuse arrows with magic. Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">immunity</LSTag> to nonmagical attacks and damage.
Magic Arrow Infusion
Arrows fired from this weapon overcome <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">immunity</LSTag> to nonmagical attacks and damage.
Banishing Arrow
You use Abjuration magic to try to temporarily <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BANISHED">banish</LSTag> your target to a harmless location in the Feywild.

The creature hit by the arrow takes an additional [1] force damage and must succeed on a <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> or be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BANISHED">banished</LSTag>. At the end of its next turn, the target reappears in the space it vacated or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
Beguiling Arrow
Beguiling Arrow Target
Beguiling Arrow Choose Ally
Beguiling Arrow Ally
Beguiling Arrow Followup
Beguiling Arrow Ally Link
Your Enchantment magic causes this arrow to temporarily <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">beguile</LSTag> its target.

The creature hit by the arrow takes an additional [1] psychic damage, and you choose one of your allies within [2] of the target. The target must succeed on a <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>, or it is <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> by the chosen ally until the start of your next turn.

<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> This effect ends early if the chosen ally attacks the charmed target, deals damage to it, or forces it to make a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>. ⚠
Choose an ally within [1] of the target of your Beguiling Arrow. The creature will be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> by the chosen ally until the start of your next turn.

On a failed <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>, this creature will be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> by your chosen ally until the start of your next turn.

On a failed <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>, the target of your Beguiling Arrow will be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> by this ally until the start of your next turn.
Attempt to have the target become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> by your chosen ally until the start of your next turn.
Link to the Arcane Archer's Beguiling Arrow <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> condition.
Bursting Arrow
You imbue your arrow with force energy drawn from the school of Evocation, dealing damage to all targets within [1].
The arrow detonates after your attack. Immediately after the arrow hits the creature, the target and all other creatures within [1] take an additional [2] force damage.
Enfeebling Arrow
You weave Necromantic magic into your arrow, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RAY_OF_ENFEEBLEMENT">weakening</LSTag> your target.

The creature hit by the arrow takes an extra [1] necrotic damage. The target must also succeed on a <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>, or the damage dealt by its weapon attacks is halved until the start of your next turn.
Grasping Arrow
Grasped
When this arrow strikes its target, Conjuration magic creates grasping, poisonous brambles, reducing the target's speed and damaging it if it moves.

The creature hit by the arrow takes an extra [1] poison damage, has its speed is reduced by [2], and it takes [1] slashing damage the first time on each turn it moves without teleporting. The brambles can be removed if the target makes a successful <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> or if an ally uses the Help action.
The affected creature's speed is reduced by [1], and it takes slashing damage the first time on each turn it moves without teleporting.
Piercing Arrow
You use Transmutation magic to give your arrow an ethereal quality, damaging all targets in a [1] line.

The arrow fires forward in a [1] long line before disappearing. Each creature in that line must make a <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> or take damage as if it were hit by the arrow, plus an extra [2] piercing damage.
Seeking Arrow
Using Divination magic, you grant your arrow the ability to seek out your target, allowing the arrow to curve and twist its path in search of its prey.

If the target is within the weapon’s range and there is a path large enough for the arrow to travel to the target, the target must make a <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>. On a failed saving throw, it takes damage as if it were hit by the arrow, plus an extra [1] force damage.

If the target fails its <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> against your arrow, it sheds dim light and cannot turn <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">invisible</LSTag> until the start of your next turn.
Location Known
The affected creature's location is known to the Arcane Archer. It sheds dim light and cannot turn <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBLE">invisible</LSTag> for 1 turn.
Shadow Arrow
You weave Illusion magic into your arrow, causing it to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">occlude</LSTag> your foe’s vision with shadows.

The creature hit by the arrow takes an additional [1] psychic damage, and must succeed on a <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> or be unable to see anything farther than [2] away until the start of your next turn.
Curving Shot
Whenever you miss with a magic arrow, you can use a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to reroll that attack against a different target within [1].
You may reroll your attack roll against a different target within [1].
Cannot be targeted by Curving Shot
Can be targeted by Curving Shot
Break Free
Attempt to remove the Grasping Arrow's brambles with a successful <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag>.
Ever-Ready Shot

Your magical archery is available whenever battle starts. If you roll initiative and have no uses of <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ArcaneShot">Arcane Shot</LSTag> remaining, you regain one use of it.
Banneret

A banneret is a knight who inspires greatness in others by committing brave deeds in battle. The mere presence of one in a hamlet is enough to cause some orcs and bandits to seek easier prey. A lone banneret is a skilled warrior, but a banneret leading a band of allies can transform even the most poorly equipped militia into a ferocious war band.
Rallying Cry

When you use your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_SecondWind">Second Wind</LSTag> feature, you can choose up to three creatures within [1] of you that are allied with you. Each one regains [2], provided that the creature can see or hear you.
Choose up to three creatures within [1] of you that are allied with you. Each one regains [2], provided that the creature can see or hear you.
Royal Envoy

Knights of high standing are expected to conduct themselves with grace. You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">proficiency</LSTag> in the Persuasion skill. If you are already proficient in it, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, or Performance. Your <LSTag Tooltip="ProficiencyBonus">proficiency bonus</LSTag> is doubled for any ability check you make that uses <LSTag Tooltip="Persuasion">Persuasion</LSTag>.
Inspiring Surge

When you use your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ACTION_SURGE">Action Surge</LSTag> feature, you can choose one creature within [1] of you that is allied with you. That creature can make one <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">melee</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">ranged weapon attack</LSTag> with its <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag>, provided that it can see or hear you.
Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally can immediately use their reaction to attack the target indicated.
Respond to your ally's command and use your reaction to make an attack.
Inspiring Surge: Declare Target
Inspiring Surge Reaction
Affected entity can use a a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to attack a target indicated by the Banneret.

You have become as durable as an iron golem. Whenever you fail a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> using <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag>, you can roll again, using the new result instead.

Whenever you fail a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> using <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag>, you can roll again, using the new result instead.
Indomitable (2)
Bulwark
Bulwark (2)
Bulwark (Ally)
Indomitable (3)
Bulwark (3)

You have become as durable as an iron golem. Whenever you fail a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> using <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma ">Charisma </LSTag>, you can roll again, using the new result instead. Additionally, you may choose [1] ally within [2] who can use this feature during the same round of combat.

Whenever you fail a <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> using <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag>, you can roll again, using the new result instead.

An ally within [1] that can see or hear you may reroll a failed <LSTag Tooltip="Intelligence">Intelligence</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma ">Charisma </LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> during this round of combat.
Brute

Brutes are simple warriors who rely on mighty attacks and their own durability to overcome their enemies. Some brutes combine this physical might with tactical cunning. Others just hit things until those things stop hitting back.
Brute Force
Deal an additional [1] when you damage a target with a weapon you are <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">proficient</LSTag> in.
The damage increases by an amount based on your level in this class.
Brutish Durability
You add [1] to your <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> rolls. If you a 20 or higher on death saving throw, you regain [2].
Devastating Critical
When you land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag> with a weapon, you deal an additional [1] damage.
When you land a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">critical hit</LSTag> with a weapon, you deal additional damage equal to your Fighter level.
Survivor
At the start of each of your turns, you regain [1] if you have no more than half of your <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> left. You don't gain this benefit if you have [2].
Regains [1] at the start of their turn.
Cavalier

The archetypal cavalier excels at mounted combat. Usually born among the nobility and raised at court, a cavalier is equally at home leading a cavalry charge or exchanging repartee at a state dinner. Cavaliers also learn how to guard those in their charge from harm, often serving as the protectors of their superiors and of the weak. Compelled to right wrongs or earn prestige, many of these fighters leave their lives of comfort to embark on glorious adventure.
Born to the Saddle

As long as you are not <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INCAPACITATED">incapacitated</LSTag>, you take one quarter less falling damage. Additionally, on your first turn of combat your <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> increases by [1].
Gain an extra [1] of <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">movement speed</LSTag> on your first turn of combat.
<LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement speed</LSTag> increased by [1].
Unwavering Mark
Unwavering Mark Attack
Special Attack
Cavaliers can punish their foes for harming others a number of times equal to their Strength modifier.

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="UNWAVERING_MARKED">mark</LSTag> it, hindering its attacks and gaining an extra attack against it if it deals damage to anyone other than you.

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark it.

While within [1] of its marker, the affected entity has disadvantage on any attack not directed at its marker. If it deals damage to anyone other than its marker, the Cavalier gains an extra attack against it on their next turn.
Marked by Cavalier

While within [1] of its marker, the affected entity has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">disadvantage</LSTag> on any attack not directed at its marker. If it deals damage to anyone other than its marker, the Cavalier gains an extra attack against it on their next turn.

The extra attack is made by the Cavalier using a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action<, has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag>, and deals additional damage equal to half the Cavalier's level.
Gain a bonus melee weapon attack against your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="UNWAVERING_MARKED">mark</LSTag> if they damage anyone other than you.

Make a special melee weapon attack against your mark that has damaged another creature on their turn.

This attack is made at Advantage and deals an additional [1].
Target must be your mark that has damaged another entity.
Has targets for Unwavering Mark Attack
Entity can make a special <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UnwaveringMarkBonusAttack">melee weapon attack</LSTag> against its <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="UNWAVERING_MARKED">mark</LSTag>.
Attack Available
Available after a marked target damages another creature.
Warding Maneuver
Cavaliers can fend off strikes directed at themselves or nearby allies a number of times equal to their Constitution modifier.

When you are wielding a melee weapon or a shield, grant yourself or an ally you can see within [1] a [2] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> against an attack. If the attack hits, the target has <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> against the damage.

Grant yourself or an ally you can see within [1] a [2] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> against an attack. If the attack hits, the target has <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> against the damage.
Must be wielding an off hand melee weapon.
Must be wielding a melee weapon or shield.
Hold the Line

Enemies provoke an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">opportunity attack</LSTag> if they move [1] or more while within your reach. When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.
Hold the Line: Opportunity Attack
Attack an enemy moving [1] or more while within your reach.
Hold the Line Foe
Can't move. Restrained by an <LSTag Tooltip="OpportunityAttack">opportunity attack</LSTag> from a Cavalier.
Ferocious Charge
Rush forward in a straight line. Attempt to knock a target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag> if you attack immediately afterwards.
Ferocious Charger
Can knock a target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag> on their next attack.
Vigilant Defender
Special Reaction

Cavaliers gain a special reaction that they can take once on every other creature's turn to make an opportunity attack.

This cannot be used on the same turn their normal reaction is taken.
Psi Warrior

Awake to the psionic power within, a Psi Warrior is a fighter who augments their physical might with psi-infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, and barriers of mental force. Many githyanki train to become such warriors, as do some of the most disciplined high elves.
Psionic Energy Die

Psi Warriors harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within themselves that fuels the various psionic powers they have.

Your have a number of Psionic Energy Dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
Protective Field
Create a momentary shield of telekinetic force that reduces incoming damage.
Create a momentary shield of telekinetic force that reduces damage by [1].
Reduce damage done to you or an ally within [1] by [2] plus your Intelligence modifier ([3]).
Psionic Strike
Once on each of your turns when you damage a target within [1] with a weapon, spend one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="PsionicEnergyDice">Psionic Energy Die</LSTag> to deal an additional [2].
Psionic Strike Cooldown
Psionic Strike will be available to use again next turn.
Telekinetic Movement
Move an object or ally you can see up to [1] to an unoccupied space.
Restore Psionic Energy Die
Regain one use of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="PsionicEnergyDice">Psionic Energy Die</LSTag>
Psi-Powered Leap
Propel your body with your mind and fly to a target position.
Telekinetic Thrust
Move the target of your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="PsionicStrikeToggle">Psionic Strike</LSTag> [1] horizontally, or knock it <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">prone</LSTag>.
Available immediately after using Psionic Strike.
Telekinetic Thrust: Push
Push the target of your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="PsionicStrikeToggle">Psionic Strike</LSTag> [1] horizontally from the direction of the position you select.
Telekinetic Thrust: Prone
Knock the target of your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="PsionicStrikeToggle">Psionic Strike</LSTag> <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">prone</LSTag>.
Telekinetic Thrust Direction
Push the target from an area next to it.
Must be the target of your Psionic Strike.
Guarded Mind

You have <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> to psychic damage and can end effects on yourself that cause you to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">frightened</LSTag>.
If you start your turn <LSTag Tooltip="CharmedGroup">charmed</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">frightened</LSTag>, end the effects causing these conditions.
Bulwark of Force

Protect a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier. They gain a +[2] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag>.
Protect up to [1] creatures you can see. They gain a +[2] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag>.
Entity has half cover, giving it a +[2] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">Armour Class</LSTag> and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag>.
Telekinetic Master

While you are <LSTag Tooltip="Concentration">concentrating</LSTag> on the <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Throw_Telekinesis">Telekinesis</LSTag> spell, you may make one attack with a weapon as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> on your turn.
Telekinetic Master Cooldown
Entity has used the bonus attack from <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="TelekineticMaster_ExtraAttack">Telekinetic Master</LSTag> this turn.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you finish a short rest or expend a Psionic Energy die.
Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest or expend a Psionic Energy die.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> You cannot push a target into a space occupied by another creature.
Rune Knight
Rune Knights enhance their martial prowess using the supernatural power of runes, an ancient practice that originated with giants.
Rune Carver
You gain <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">proficiency</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight of Hand</LSTag> and you can use magic runes to enhance your abilities.
Rune Magic

You create magic runes that enhance your abilities and can be invoked to produce special effects. You regain all expended invocation uses of these Runes on a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">short</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">long rest</LSTag>.
You can invoke a rune once per <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">short</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">long rest</LSTag>. This increases to twice at level 15.
Inscribe Rune
You can inscribe a rune you know. Each rune offers passive magical benefits and unlocks a unique action.
Each rune you know can be inscribed once, and lasts until you finish a <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">long rest</LSTag>.
Inscribe Cloud Rune

Inscribe a rune that emulates the deceptive magic used by some Cloud Giants to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight Of Hand</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag>.
This rune can be invoked to transfer an Attack to another target.
Inscribe Fire Rune

Inscribe a rune that channels the masterful craftsmanship of great smiths to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Expertise">expertise</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight Of Hand</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag>.
This Rune can be invoked to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RESTRAINED">restrain</LSTag> and deal additional fire damage to a creature you hit with an attack using a weapon.
Inscribe Frost Rune

Inscribe a rune that evokes the might of those who survive in the wintry wilderness, such as frost giants, to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AnimalHandling">Animal Handling</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag>.
This rune can be invoked to increase your chance at succeeding on Strength and Constitution rolls.
Inscribe Stone Rune

Inscribe a rune that channels the judiciousness associated with Stone Giants to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Insight">Insight</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Darkvision">darkvision</LSTag>.
This rune can be invoked to force a creature into a dreamy stupor.
Inscribe Hill Rune

Inscribe a rune that bestows a resilience reminiscent of a Hill Giant to gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag> against being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">poisoned</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> against poison damage.
This rune can be invoked to apply <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">resistance</LSTag> against physical damage.
Inscribe Storm Rune

Inscribe a rune that allows you to glimpse the future like a Storm Giant seer and gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Arcana">Arcana</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag> and immunity to being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SURPRISED">surprised</LSTag>.
This rune can be invoked to apply <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">disadvantage</LSTag> to rolls.
Cloud Rune

You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight Of Hand</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag>. In addition, you may invoke this rune and use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to transfer an attack to another target.
Cloud Rune Invocation
Rune Knights can emulate the deceptive magic used by some cloud giants.
Invoke Cloud Rune

When you or a creature you can see within [1] is hit by an attack, you can use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to invoke the rune and nullify the damage and redirect the attack to a random target within [1].
Within Range of Cloud Rune Attack
Entity may be the target of the attack generated from invoking a Cloud Rune.
Cloud Rune Attack
Attack a target declared by the Rune Knight who has invoked a Cloud Rune.
Declare Cloud Rune Attack Target
Choose a target you can see within [1] of you. The creature affected by your Cloud Rune invocation will immediately make an attack against the target regardless of the attack's range.
Deceived
Entity will attack a nearby target on command.
Fire Rune

You have <LSTag Tooltip="Expertise">expertise</LSTag> in <LSTag Tooltip="SleightOfHand">Sleight Of Hand</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag>. In addition, you can invoke this rune to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RESTRAINED">restrain</LSTag> and deal additional fire damage to a creature you hit with an attack using a weapon.
Fire Rune Invocation
Rune Knights can channel the masterful craftsmanship of great smiths.
Invoke Fire Rune
When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, you can deal an extra [1] and possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="RESTRAINED">restrain</LSTag> the target.
Flame Shackled

Entity takes [1] every turn and cannot move. <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack rolls</LSTag> against the affected entity have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag>, while the entity's attack rolls and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag> have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">disadvantage</LSTag>.
Frost Rune Invocation
Rune Knights can evoke the might of those who survive in the wintry wilderness, such as frost giants.
Frost Rune

You have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AnimalHandling">Animal Handling</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Intimidation">Intimidation</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SkillChecks">checks</LSTag>. In addition, you can invoke this rune as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> to increase your sturdiness.
Invoke Frost Rune
